summary: The season of silly has returned, sponsored by Colonel Swain! Structured changes across 10 entities this patch.

champions.name: Cassiopeia
champions.tldr: Base mana increased to 480 from 450.; Bonus base damage increased to 20–120 from 20–112.
champions.gameplayImpact: Cassiopeia is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Bonus base damage
lines.note: Bonus base damage increased to 20–120 from 20–112.

champions.name: Graves
champions.tldr: Base attack damage reduced to 66 from 68.
champions.gameplayImpact: Graves loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Base attack damage
lines.note: Base attack damage reduced to 66 from 68.

champions.name: Kalista
champions.tldr: AD ratio per subsequent spear increased to 20–50% AD from 20–40% AD.

lines.label: AD ratio per subsequent spear
lines.note: AD ratio per subsequent spear increased to 20–50% AD from 20–40% AD.
